title: Fatherland (bc30)
synopsis:
In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick, which takes them across a Germany in ruins. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also a deep fracture within his own family. With Fatherland, Pawlikowski explores the themes of identity, family, love and guilt amid the turmoil and confusion of post-war Europe in his elliptical, distilled style.

 

Best Director Award, Cannes Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
1949 年二戰結束幾年，冷戰緊接開始，東西兩德分裂，宛如諾貝爾文學獎得主湯瑪斯曼與其女兒艾莉卡曼疏離的關係。父女二人駕着黑色老爺車穿越德國不復完整的國土，從受美軍控制的法蘭克福到蘇聯管制的威瑪，彭域高斯基貫徹《冷戰戀曲》和《修女伊德》的黑白美學，將人物關係在冷峻森嚴的構圖中擠壓至極致。湯瑪斯曼流亡美國 16 年，重返故園領受文學榮譽，卻是家已不成家，國也不成國。

 

康城影展 最佳導演獎
